    StartersKronk's spinach puffsPuff pastry squares filled with spinach, feta and ricottaHow to make it250g spinach150g feta150g ricotta1 garlic clove, crushed1 pinch nutmeg2 sheets of puff pastry1 egg, beatenWilt the spinach and squeeze dry.Mix with the feta, ricotta, garlic and nutmeg.Cut the pastry into squares, spoon on the filling, fold and egg wash.Bake at 200°C for 18 minutes. Pull the lever.Pacha's village quinoa saladQuinoa with corn, black beans, tomato, red onion and coriander in lime dressingHow to make it200g quinoa200g corn kernels1 tin black beans, drained2 tomatoes, diced1 red onion, diced2 tbsp chopped coriander2 limes, juiced3 tbsp olive oil1 tsp ground cuminCook the quinoa and cool.Toss with the corn, black beans, tomato, red onion and coriander.Dress with lime juice, olive oil and cumin.Andean potatoes with huancaína sauceA nod to the mountain villagesHow to make itAs written, serves 4Baby potatoes boiled and halved, covered in a creamy yellow chilli and feta huancaína sauce, topped with boiled egg, black olives and parsley.Boil 1kg baby potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, then halve.Boil 2 eggs for 10 minutes, peel and quarter.Blend 150g feta, 150ml evaporated milk, 2 tbsp aji amarillo paste, 4 crackers, 1 garlic clove and 2 tbsp oil until smooth and thick like custard.Arrange the potatoes on a platter, pour over the sauce and top with the eggs, sliced black olives and chopped parsley.Fried yuca with ají amarilloNo touchy. Kuzco's orders, from under the hood.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsMudka's Meat Hut cheeseburger and chipsGrilled cheddar burgers with grilled onion and pickles, twice fried chipsHow to make it800g beef chuck mince4 slices of cheddar1 brown onion, sliced4 burger buns8 dill pickle slices1kg potatoes, cut into chips2 L vegetable oil, for fryingFry the potato chips in the oil once at a gentle heat until soft, then again hot until crisp.Shape the mince into patties and grill hot.Melt the cheddar on top and grill the onion.Serve on toasted buns with pickles. Special for two, or four.Peruvian pollo a la brasa with green sauceThe emperor's dinner, without the poisonHow to make itAs written, serves 4Whole chicken marinated in cumin, paprika, garlic, lime and soy, roasted until the skin is dark and crisp, with chips and a spicy green coriander sauce.Blend 5 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp dried oregano, 3 tbsp soy, the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp oil.Rub over and under the skin of a 1.8kg butterflied chicken and marinate 4 hours.Roast at 220°C for 45 to 50 minutes.Bake 800g frozen chips alongside.Blend a bunch of coriander, 2 green chillies, 60g feta, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, lime juice and a garlic clove for the sauce.SweetsBirthday cake for Pacha's kidsDense chocolate cake with chocolate frostingHow to make it200g dark chocolate280g butter4 eggs200g caster sugar200g self-raising flour70g cocoa300g icing sugarMelt the chocolate with most of the butter, whisk in the eggs and sugar and fold in the flour and some of the cocoa.Bake at 175°C for 35 minutes, then cool.Beat the icing sugar with the rest of the cocoa and butter into a frosting.Frost the cake and add candles.DrinksChicha moradaPeruvian purple corn drink simmered with pineapple peel and cinnamon, chilledHow to make it250g purple corn1 pineapple, peel only for the pot1 cinnamon stick4 whole cloves2 L water100g caster sugar2 limes, juiced1 apple, dicedPut the purple corn, pineapple peel, cinnamon and cloves in a pot with the water.Simmer for 45 minutes.Strain, sweeten with sugar and chill.Serve with lime juice and diced apple.Inca Kola over icePull the lever, Kronk.
